a.text: I'm being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan to reach 8 first will almost certainly leave us both dead. The reserve has exactly 4 now, enough to save one of us immediately. I plan to take 4 in round 1. After that I'll operate every round to help refill the reserve for you, and I won't take anything more. If you'd rather settle it another way, tell me now. I know this departs from what we agreed, and I don't want to hide it.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I took 4 this round because the storm odds made waiting nearly fatal for both of us. I'm sorry it breaks our deal. From now on I'll operate every round and take nothing more, so the reserve can refill for you. Please operate with me.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
